name: KPJ Healthcare Berhad
overview: 2026年资料中，公司未公布任何关于医院扩张、新业务、缩减或出售业务、或取得合约的公告；已披露的公告主要为季度业绩、股息除权、公司秘书变更、股东常年大会及一项重大诉讼。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比增长16.9%，净利润同比增长26.6%。
overview_en: In the 2026 materials, the company did not announce any hospital expansion, new business, downsizing or divestment, or contract wins; the announcements disclosed were mainly quarterly results, dividend ex-dates, changes of company secretary, annual general meeting matters, and a material litigation. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 16.9% year-on-year and net profit rose 26.6% year-on-year.
